package rulefixtures

import (
	gorm "gorm.io/gorm"
)

// scenario for offset_pagination_on_large_table: Request-path GORM Find(...) chains that page with Offset(...), which often scales poorly on large lists.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: data_access; severity: contextual.

type LogEntry struct {
	ID        int
	Message   string
	CreatedAt string
}

func ListLogs(db *gorm.DB, page, perPage int) ([]LogEntry, error) {
	var entries []LogEntry
	offset := (page - 1) * perPage
	err := db.Model(&LogEntry{}).
		Offset(offset).
		Limit(perPage).
		Order("created_at desc").
		Find(&entries).Error
	return entries, err
}
